fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: This program aims to train international medical health care service talents. This program will refer to international standards for medical education, mainly aiming at cultivating internationally universal medical practitioner with substantial medical preclinical knowledge, normative clinical skills & favorable professional quality, taking international requests of source countries of international students the requests of the students to return to their motherland to serve other country into appropriate accounts, allowing the graduates to become practitioner to offer service of medical treatment, education research in medical health care service sectors. Lectures of this major will be given in English all the way to top students of all countries in the world who aspire to study research medical science. Graduates may participate in the Examination of Doctors Qualifications as per the relevant rules of the countries after graduation. 2. Major courses Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses for international students. Systematic Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Preventive medicine, Evidence-based Medicine, Diagnostics, Introduction to Surgery, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Neurology, Psychiatry, Medical Ethics, Chinese, etc. 3. University Size Editor Notes: Now GXMU has 5 affiliated hospitals and 11 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals. Currently,GXMU has five affiliated hospitals under its direct administration. Among them, the first Affiliated Hospital, the Affiliated Tumor Hospital and the Hospital of Stomatology are the largest"Grade 3 Class A" hospital in Guangxi.They play a leading rolein higher medical education,medical scientific research and health services in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. GXMU has 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals in 7 major cities of Guangxi.These hospitals are the largest hospitals in these cities and they are also teaching hospitals of GXMU. 4. Scientific Research Innovation Editor Notes: GXMU has advantages in scientific research and has won fund project and grants. GXMU has advantages in the researches on common diseases and frequently-occuring diseases in Guangxi and reached the international advanced level, such as prevention and treatment of regional high-incidence tumor, prevention and treatment of thalassernia,hemoglobin research,snake venom research,prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease,drug research,liver transplantation,finger repantation,perlpheral blood stem cell transplantation,etc. Since the 11th Five-Year Plan,GXMU has won one National Key R&D project,one National Social Science Fund project, and has won grants from the National Science Foundation of China for 808 research projects,ranking in the forefront of universities in Guangxi. Researchers of GXMU have published 3079 SCI papers in top internatiinal journals such as New England Journal of Medicine, Nature Biotechnology and Nature Genetics as the first author or correspondent.More than 270 projects have won National Science and Technology Award,Ministry of Education Science and Technology Award,Guangxi Science and Technology Progress Award and Guangxi Science Award. 5. Joint Degree Program Editor Notes: GXMU will provide more and more joint degree program in the near future. In 2013, the joint bachelor's degree program in Information Management and Information Systemin collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approved by the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. In 2014, the joint bachelor's degree program in Public Service Administration in collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approvedby the Ministry of Education. 6. University Brief Introduction Editor Notes: Guangxi Medical University is recognized by the WHO. Guangxi Medical University (GXMU), founded in 1934, is one of the 22 oldest medical institutes in China and one of the first 8 qualified to enroll international students. It is located in a border city-Nanning, capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. The school covers an area of 98.8 acres and enrolls 8,800 students. Beginning in 1978, international education in GXMU has become rather mature and complete. Currently, more than 300 foreign students from Vietnam, Indonesia, Nepal, India, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and the United States are studying here. The Clinical Medicine in Chinese was set up in 1978, and the English-medium program started in 2001. GXMU has rich experiences in medical education. And, there were graduates for years; the average rate of acquiring Medical License is 90%. In 2008, the English-medium MBBS program is recognized by MOE as the first batch of qualified universities. Now it recruits about 700 international students from India, Nepal, Vietnam, Indonesia, Mauritius, and Sri Lanka, etc. GXMU is recognized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. Learn More>> 7.Campus Life Editor Notes: Students will have a wonderful campus life in GXMU. Campus Gate Xinghu Lake SIE Building

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport Photo Page Copy -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. -The passport must be valid for 2 months beyond the enrollment date. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. English proficiency test certificate * 6. Study plan A study plan of more than 500 words, focusing on the study plan of the applied major. Applicants must write in the language of the applied major. * 7. 3-minute video Record in the language of the applied major. * 8. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a a Chinese Embassy's designated hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 10. Financial Proof Bank statement showing at least 1 year of study and living expenses. * 11. Personal CV/Resume -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. * 12. Electronic Signature * 13. Letter of good faith undertaking You can download a template or sample from here . * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -The compulsory subjects for GXMU are mathematics and chemistry. Applicants for the undergraduate clinical medicine program (taught in English) (MBBS) must choose the English test paper and do not need to provide Chinese subject scores; Applicants for other programs must choose the Chinese test paper and must provide STEM Chinese; Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Age requirements: 16 to 30 years old. If the applicant is under 18 years old (born after October 30, 2007) at the time of application, they must provide information of their legal guardian and a guardianship authorization signed by all three parties. 2. Nationality requirements: Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. The nationality requirement must comply with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of China. 3. Basical requirements: good health, friendly towards China, and non-criminal record. 4. CSCA subjects requirements: (1) The compulsory subjects for GXMU are mathematics and chemistry. (2) Applicants for the undergraduate clinical medicine program (taught in English) (MBBS) must choose the English test paper and do not need to provide Chinese subject scores; 5. Applicants for the clinical medicine program (taught in English) must provide an IELTS (total score > 5.5, item score > 5), or a TOEFL iBT (total score ≥ 70), or a TOEFL iTP (total score ≥ 450), or a Duolingo score > 90) transcript; or other English scores recognized by our university.
